stem:
Hitesh prepares mixtures. In a uniform mixture the components are spread so evenly that they cannot be seen separately.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Honey stirred completely into warm water until nothing separate can be seen is a uniform mixture.
Poha mixed with peanuts and green chilli pieces is a non-uniform mixture.
Mustard oil poured onto a bowl of water is a uniform mixture.
Chalk powder stirred into a bucket of water is a uniform mixture.

teacher.key_rationale: Honey fully mixed into water is uniform. Poha with separate pieces is non-uniform. Oil on water and chalk in water still show separate parts.
